title: RADIO FM - CONTENTS
summary: RPO U69 AM/FM radio: contents of the U69 sheets, with an overview drawing showing where each part goes (receiver and capacitors behind the dash, speaker under the dash, spark plug and distributor/coil ignition shields and plug wiring on the engine, rear-deck antenna and its cable). Sheet A8 is canceled.
notes_internal: Title block: UPC U69, sheet A1, model 19000, C/O A1, drawing 3965172, K423.
Overview drawing tags: A2/A4 (receiver), A3 (speaker, two places), A5/A6/A7 (ignition shield on engine), A8 (rocker area, sheet canceled), B1 (antenna), B2 (antenna cable).
Circled 2 at the ignition shield = revision 2; circled 3 at A8 = revision 3; circled 1 above the drawing number = revision 1.
